detaileddescription.para: Population variance: Σ(x - mean)² / N, returned as Q16.16. Returns 0 if fewer than 2 samples.

briefdescription.para: Get sample at index (0 = oldest, count-1 = newest).

detaileddescription.para: Returns 0 if the window is empty.

briefdescription.para: Signal Crest Factor in Q16.16: Peak / RMS.

detaileddescription.para: Measures signal peakiness (e.g. 1.414 for sine wave). Returns 0 if RMS is 0 or window is empty.

briefdescription.para: Mean signal power in Q16.16: Σ(x²) / N.

detaileddescription.para: Returns 0 if the window is empty.
Maintains a circular buffer of samples and computes statistics incrementally. Designed for sensor data conditioning.
All math is integer-only. Mean and variance use Q16.16 for fractional precision without floating point.
